real_world.title: Cafe pickup call
real_world.text: In a Korean cafe, you will hear 주문하신 음료 나왔습니다 when your drink is ready.
glosses: your drink is ready

real_world.title: Restaurant service phrase
real_world.text: Your server will say ごゆっくりお召し上がりください, so please take your time.
phrases: ごゆっくりお召し上がりください
glosses: please take your time and enjoy your meal

real_world.title: Restaurant menu
real_world.text: Tonight's special is えびと野菜の天ぷら盛り合わせ, served with matcha salt.
phrases: えびと野菜の天ぷら盛り合わせ
glosses: assorted shrimp and vegetable tempura

real_world.title: After a meal
real_world.text: At the end of a meal, you can say ごちそうさまでした.
glosses: thank you for the meal

real_world.title: Shop greeting
real_world.text: As you walk in, the staff will greet you with 어서 오세요, 찾으시는 거 있으세요?
glosses: welcome — are you looking for anything?

real_world.title: Subway announcement
real_world.text: This station is 고속터미널, 고속터미널 Station. The doors are on your left.
glosses: Express Bus Terminal (station name)

real_world.title: Subway announcement
real_world.text: This station is 홍대입구, 홍대입구 Station. Please transfer here for line two.
glosses: Hongik University Entrance (station name)

real_world.title: Leaving the office
real_world.text: When leaving the office, you can say お先に失礼します.
glosses: excuse me for leaving before you

real_world.title: Business greeting
real_world.text: The most useful business phrase is よろしくお願いいたします.
phrases: よろしくお願いいたします
glosses: I look forward to working with you

real_world.title: Ending a work call
real_world.text: Koreans often end a work call with 확인해 보고 다시 연락드리겠습니다.
glosses: I will check and get back to you

real_world.title: Language-learning content
real_world.text: Today's key expression is 시간 내 주셔서 정말 감사합니다, which you can use at the end of a meeting.
glosses: thank you so much for making the time

real_world.title: Tour guide
real_world.text: Our next stop is 조선 왕조의 정궁인 경복궁, followed by a walk through 북촌 한옥마을의 좁은 골목길.
glosses: Gyeongbokgung, the main royal palace of the Joseon dynasty
the narrow alleys of Bukchon Hanok Village

real_world.title: Museum exhibition
real_world.text: The exhibition features 江戸時代の浮世絵の名作 from the museum's own collection.
phrases: 江戸時代の浮世絵の名作
glosses: masterpieces of Edo-period ukiyo-e woodblock prints

real_world.title: Dessert course
real_world.text: For dessert, we shared un fondant au chocolat coulant, still warm from the oven.
glosses: a molten chocolate fondant

real_world.title: Christmas market
real_world.text: The Christmas market smelled of frisch geröstete Maronen und Glühwein everywhere.
glosses: freshly roasted chestnuts and mulled wine
gloss_pairs: freshly roasted chestnuts and mulled wine

real_world.title: Dessert menu
real_world.text: The dessert menu's highlight is une tarte aux pommes maison, served warm.
glosses: a homemade apple tart

real_world.title: Lunch classic
real_world.text: The lunch classic here is Bratkartoffeln mit Speck und Zwiebeln, crispy at the edges.
glosses: pan-fried potatoes with bacon and onions
gloss_pairs: pan-fried potatoes with bacon and onions

real_world.title: Cheese course
real_world.text: The cheese course featured un plateau de fromages affinés with fig jam.
glosses: a platter of aged cheeses

real_world.title: Family recipe
real_world.text: Grandma's recipe calls for hausgemachter Apfelstrudel mit Vanillesoße on Sundays.
glosses: homemade apple strudel with vanilla sauce
gloss_pairs: homemade apple strudel with vanilla sauce

phrase_comparison.phrase: practical workshops aligned with our buying committee
phrase_comparison.sentence: 지난달 우리 팀이 도입한 기업 간 영업 컨설팅사는 기대보다 훨씬 실무적이었고, 리뷰를 남길 만큼 인상이 좋았다. 첫 진단 미팅에서 a clear account-based sales playbook 으로 논의를 정리해 주니, 영업대표와 마케팅 담당자가 같은 언어로 문제를 보게 됐다. 워크숍은 practical workshops aligned with our buying committee 와 실제 고객 미팅 사례를 엮어 진행돼, 강의보다 공동 설계에 가까웠다. 특히 actionable pipeline diagnostics grounded in real CRM data 가 가장 도움이 됐는데, 막연했던 리드 품질 문제와 딜 지연 원인이 숫자로 보였다. 마지막 제안서에 담긴 a lightweight operating model for cross-functional execution 과 transparent ROI assumptions for the first six months 까지 설득력 있어, 비용은 높지만 재계약은 긍정적으로 검토 중이다.

phrase_comparison.phrase: lean household operations with zero emotional overhead
phrase_comparison.sentence: 퇴근하고 집에 오자마자 운동복을 세탁기에 넣었는데, 오늘은 minimum viable weekday morning routine 으로 내일 입을 양말이랑 머그컵까지 미리 챙겼다. 싱크대에 컵 두 개랑 접시 하나만 남겨두기 싫어서 lean household operations with zero emotional overhead 처럼 바로 치웠고, 냉장고 앞 메모에는 data driven grocery budget tracking system 의 잔액을 작게 적어놨다. 베란다 화분에 물 주는 사이 고양이는 새 택배 박스에 들어가서 weekly user research session with a very picky stakeholder 에 참여하는 표정으로 나를 봤다. 별거 아닌 집안일도 이렇게 이름을 붙이면 묘하게 게임 같고, 잠들기 전 마음이 조금 정리된다.

full_sentence.sentence: After the rain, I ducked into a tiny old-school cafe by the station, and the 深煎り豆をネルで落とす香り made my whole jacket smell like comfort. The owner gave me a smile that said ごゆっくりお召し上がりください, not fussy, just warm. I took the corner seat and watched steam blur the window, feeling a sort of 雨上がりの縁側で飲むほうじ茶 settle into the evening. Next time, I’m bringing a book and pretending I don’t have notifications. Honestly, it beat any fancy latte art.
phrases: 深煎り豆をネルで落とす香り
ごゆっくりお召し上がりください
雨上がりの縁側で飲むほうじ茶
glosses: the aroma of dark-roasted beans brewed through a flannel filter
please take your time and enjoy it
roasted green tea sipped on a veranda after the rain

full_sentence.sentence: Han’s slim novel reads like a review of everything we keep misplacing: names, rooms, the voices of the dead. The 첫눈 녹듯 사라지는 어머니의 마지막 손길 gives the opening its ache, while the 제사상에 올린 식어 가는 흰밥 한 그릇 turns grief into something almost domestic. By the final chapter, even 봄비에 젖은 벚꽃잎이 흩어진 골목 feels less symbolic than inevitable. I admired its restraint; it left me quiet, not devastated, and somehow that was worse.
phrases: 첫눈 녹듯 사라지는 어머니의 마지막 손길
제사상에 올린 식어 가는 흰밥 한 그릇
glosses: last trace of a mother’s touch fading like first snow
cooling bowl of white rice set out for the ancestors
an alley strewn with cherry petals wet from spring rain
